name: refund-specialist
description: Decides and executes refunds for UK card tickets within policy; escalates above £250.

skills.name: Assess refund
skills.description: Reads the ticket and the refund policy, returns a decision with reason.

skills.name: Issue refund
skills.description: Issues a refund up to £250; above that returns ESCALATE.

_note: Served by the container at :9000/.well-known/agent-card.json; reached via <runtime invocations URL>/.well-known/agent-card.json or get_agent_card. Shape per a2a-sdk; verify field names against the installed a2a version.
